mstts:express-as.prosody: Imagine tracing the story of humanity, not through dates and battles, but through the drinks we've shared—think about it: from that first ancient sip of beer to the familiar fizz of a cola. Welcome to this journey where we uncover just how deeply our favorite beverages are woven into the tapestry of civilization. Inspired by Tom Standage's fascinating work, "A History of the World in 6 Glasses," we're about to explore how six iconic drinks—beer, wine, spirits, coffee, tea, and cola—have shaped our world in ways you might never have imagined. These aren’t just refreshments; they’re vessels of power, symbols of change, and sparks for innovation. We’ll see how beer helped build the earliest communities, how wine became the soul of classical societies, and how spirits fueled adventure and trade. Coffee? It jump-started revolutions of thought. Tea? It powered empires. And cola, believe it or not, turned into a true icon of modern life and globalization. Through these six glasses, we’ll discover how everyday rituals connect us to the rise and fall of empires, the spread of ideas, and the making of the modern world. So, let’s raise a glass together—because the drinks we choose shape much more than just our tastes. They shape history itself.
